cohort: 2758 women who gave birth and 361 women with singleton term newborns with normal birth weight (<4000 g) at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at the Cantonal Hospital Zenica between January 1, 2018 and December 31, 2018
finding: Macrosomia was observed in 13.05% of births and was associated with a higher risk of operative delivery.
mod_finding: The overall Cesarean section rate for macrosomic infants was 23.2%, while 76.1% underwent an attempt of labor delivered vaginally.
birth_weight: Mentioned (>4000 g for macrosomic infants, <4000 g for control group)
